# Lot & Loaded — full text

Lot & Loaded originates off-market commercial parcels — industrial land, redevelopment and teardown sites — and puts them under contract at 65% of builder value. Builders are qualified on closing pace and see deals that fit their buy box. Partners register parcels with us, locked for 30 days, and keep 50% of the collected fee. Free to join; Lot & Loaded earns an assignment fee only when a transaction closes.


===== Lot & Loaded — Off-Market Commercial Land, Priced Right (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/index.html)

Lot & Loaded — Off-Market Commercial Land, Priced Right LOT &amp; LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property Off-market commercial land &amp; teardown sites — Florida first; industrial lane 5+ acres Lot &amp; Loaded: good dirt, priced right, brought to people who close. Builders in our community see deals that fit their box. Partners bring us the dirt and split the fee. Free to join. No membership fees — we make money when deals close, same as you. No listing, no showings, no broker fees. Tell us about your property Our standard: quality and time We function on quality and time , and that's what we give people. Sellers get one plain contract and a closing date they agree to. Partners get paid when deals close. So every builder in this community is qualified on closing pace before a single deal goes out — a slow close ties up everybody's money, and we don't do that to our sellers or our partners. How it works 1. Deals are originated owner-direct Our partners work owners directly — no daisy chains, no recycled lists. Every parcel is verified: zoning, acreage, ownership. 2. Every parcel passes a full gate Criteria fit, numbers, recorded comps. We price at 65% of builder value — what a builder credibly pays for the dirt, figured from recorded comps — never off a seller's ask. 3. Qualified builders get the drop Deals go only to builders whose box they fit, fastest closers first, on a stated clock. Clean packet: the deal, the numbers, the timeline. Questions before you start? The builder form takes about three minutes and asks only what we need to match you with the right parcels. Partner registration takes two. What we buy Development land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, and industrial outdoor storage yards. Our industrial lane works sites of five acres and up; other commercial parcels are reviewed on fit. Everything is originated owner-direct and off-market — we do not work fresh listings, and we do not touch daisy chains. If a parcel cannot be verified — zoning, acreage, ownership — it does not go out to builders. If it can, it is priced off recorded comps and matched to the builders whose box it fits. What it costs Free for builders, partners, and sellers — no membership, seat, per-lead, or per-deal charges for joining, listing, or registering, ever. Lot & Loaded earns one way: an assignment fee inside the transaction itself when a deal closes — paid at the closing table, never billed to a builder, partner, or seller, and it never reduces a seller's agreed price. If a deal does not close, we do not earn, and nobody owes us anything for looking. How an offer is made Once a parcel clears the gate, we take it to qualified builders whose box it fits — fastest closers first, on a stated first-look clock. Terms are agreed up front: the assignment, earnest money, and the closing date. If a builder passes, we say so and move to the next fit. When a contract is signed, title runs the assignment and the clock is watched all the way to the closing table. We work Florida first, where our builder bench is deepest, and we take on new markets builder by builder — never by spraying listings. See a deal packet Every parcel that goes out to builders travels as a packet: the property, the recorded comps, the pricing math, and the proposed structure on one page. Select… Off-market — no contact yet Off-market — in conversation Listed — 90+ days on market Tax deed / foreclosure exposure Under contract with the house Anything HQ should know — motivation, condition, site flags Register this parcel Submitting registers the lead under your name with a 30-day lock, starting now. Unregistered leads are not protected. Hand-worked outreach only — your own phone, your own accounts. Registered. Your 30-day lock starts now. HQ runs the gate — criteria fit, numbers, comps, buyer match — and comes back with the number. No offer goes to the seller before that, from anyone. How a registration works One: register the parcel before first contact — the lock starts at submission and runs 30 days. Two: HQ runs the full gate: criteria fit, the numbers, recorded comps, and a match against qualified builders' buy boxes. Three: the house prices the offer — no offer goes to a seller from anyone until that happens. Four: the deal goes to qualified builders, fastest closers first, on a stated clock. Five: when the assignment fee is collected, your 50% is paid. Registration is free, and it is the only way a lead is protected — unregistered leads are first come, first served. What counts as a lead The property address, the owner's name — the signer, not a gatekeeper — and a skip-traced phone that reaches them. Acreage and zoning help the gate move faster. Listed deals need 90 or more days on market. Hand-worked outreach only: your own phone, your own accounts. What HQ does for free Skip-tracing the owner, running the recorded comps, pricing the offer, writing the outreach, working every reply, and matching the deal to qualified builders — the house does all of it, on every registered lead, at no cost to you. Your job is finding parcels worth registering: off-market, owner-direct, with the owner reachable. Where to find them: tax-delinquent industrial parcels, long-held family land, estates with out-of-state heirs, and owners paying carrying costs on vacant warehouses that no longer serve them. If a parcel is already under contract with another wholesaler, or the house is already working the owner, we tell you at registration — not after you have spent a week on it. Questions, answered straight How does the 30-day lock work? Register a parcel before first contact and the lead is locked to you for 30 days, starting the moment you submit. During your lock we do not work that parcel around you — if the fee lands on it, your split lands with it. Unregistered leads are not protected. When and how do I get paid? The assignment fee is typically 5% of the contract price. You keep 50% of the net fee actually collected on your deals, paid when the fee lands. It is 100% commission — no salary, no hourly, no draw. Can I send the seller an offer myself? No. HQ runs the full gate — criteria fit, numbers, recorded comps, buyer match — and prices every offer. No offer goes to a seller until the house runs it, from anyone. What makes a lead count? The property address, the owner's name, and a skip-traced phone that reaches the owner. A lead without the owner and a phone is not a lead yet — get them first, then register. What kinds of parcels fit? Off-market commercial and industrial property: development land, warehouses and industrial buildings, teardown and redevelopment sites, and outdoor storage yards. Listed deals need 90 or more days on market. Lot & Loaded — partner registration. Terms: 50/50 of the fee actually collected, paid when collected. ===== Sample Deal Packet | Lot & Loaded (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/sample-deal.html)

Sample Deal Packet | Lot &amp; Loaded LOT &amp; LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property Sample deal packet What a deal packet looks like. SAMPLE — this property and every number on this page are illustrative. This is not a live listing and nothing here is for sale. It shows the exact format a real parcel travels in when it goes out to qualified builders: the property, the recorded-comp logic, the pricing math, and the proposed structure, on one page. The property (sample) 7.4 acres, vacant industrial land with a fenced yard — Hialeah area, Miami-Dade County, Florida. Zoning IU-2 (industrial). Flat, rectangular, paved yard area, utilities at the street, direct arterial access. Held by the same family entity for 20+ years. Current use: leased informally as truck parking, month to month. The comps behind the value (sample) Recorded sales of similar industrial land in the same submarket, most recent first: · 6.9 acres, 1.2 miles — sold at $398,000 per acre (recorded, 2026) · 8.1 acres, 2.0 miles — sold at $421,000 per acre (recorded, 2025) · 5.5 acres, 0.8 miles — sold at $405,000 per acre (recorded, 2025) Median ≈ $405,000 per acre . That median is what we call builder value : what builders credibly pay for dirt like this, from the record — not an appraisal and not a seller's asking price. The pricing math (sample) Builder value: 7.4 acres × $405,000 = $2,997,000 Contract price at 65% of builder value: $1,948,000 Assignment fee, 5% of contract price: $97,400 — paid inside the transaction at closing; the seller's contract price does not change. The proposed structure (sample) · Seller signs one purchase contract with Lot &amp; Loaded at the contract price. · The contract is assigned to a qualified builder from our bench; the assignment is named in the paperwork. · Earnest money posted on signing; closing cash, as-is, inside 30 days of a clear title commitment. · Due diligence: zoning and use confirmed against the county record before the packet goes out; environmental and survey are the closing builder's, on the contract clock. What was verified before this packet went out (sample) · Ownership: the signing entity matches the county record; the person who signed can sign. · Zoning and use: industrial use confirmed against the county's published zoning — not the seller's word for it. · Acreage and access: parcel dimensions and road frontage checked against the property appraiser's record. · Tenure: held 20+ years by the same entity — long-held, off-market, never listed. · Liens and taxes: no open tax delinquency found on the county roll at packet date; the title commitment at contract is the final word. The timeline a real packet runs on (sample) Day 0 — the packet goes to qualified builders whose buy box it fits, fastest closers first. Days 1–2 — first-look window: a builder can take it, pass it, or ask for the underlying file; a pass is an answer, not a delay. On a take — the seller's contract is signed, earnest money posts, and the assignment to the closing builder is executed with it. Inside 30 days of a clear title commitment — the closing, cash, as-is. If no builder takes the packet inside the window, it comes back to us and we say so plainly: re-priced, re-matched, or released. Questions builders ask about packets Is the 65% negotiable? The packet price is the price the seller has agreed to. Our gate priced it off recorded comps; a builder who wants the dirt at a different number is passing, and we move to the next fit. Who holds the contract before closing? Lot &amp; Loaded signs with the seller and assigns to the closing builder — the assignment is part of the paperwork every party signs, and our fee is paid inside the transaction at closing. What if title comes back dirty? The contract's own terms govern — cure period, extension, or exit — the same as any commercial purchase. Nobody is asked to close over a title problem in silence. What happens next on a real deal The packet goes only to qualified builders whose buy box the parcel fits — fastest closers first, on a stated first-look clock. If a builder passes, we say so and move to the next fit. Get qualified to see packets like this one, or register a parcel if you find the dirt. Lot &amp; Loaded — off-market commercial origination. Questions: call or text (838) 304-3003 · Terms · Privacy

===== Terms | Lot & Loaded (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/terms.html)

Terms | Lot &amp; Loaded LOT &amp; LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property Terms How this works, in plain terms. Last updated October 26, 2026. What Lot &amp; Loaded is Lot &amp; Loaded originates off-market commercial property — industrial land, redevelopment and teardown sites, warehouses, and outdoor storage yards — and matches it with vetted builders and developers. Joining is free for builders, partners, and sellers. Lot &amp; Loaded is not a real estate brokerage, and nothing on this site is legal, tax, or investment advice. Every party should use its own counsel on its own paperwork. How a transaction works When a property fits, the seller signs one contract with Lot &amp; Loaded at an agreed price. Lot &amp; Loaded assigns that contract to a vetted builder from its bench, and the builder closes the purchase — cash, as-is, on the date in the contract. The assignment is disclosed in the paperwork the seller signs. Lot &amp; Loaded earns an assignment fee inside the transaction at closing; the fee never reduces the seller's agreed price and is never billed to builders, partners, or sellers. If no transaction closes, no fee is earned. Sellers Sending the seller form is not a contract and obligates you to nothing. Any number we discuss is an offer, not a commitment, until a written contract is signed by both sides. Every closing is subject to the signed contract's own terms, including title. Builders Qualification is our judgment, based on closing pace and fit with the parcels we originate. Qualification does not guarantee any volume of deals, and a parcel shown to you may be shown under a stated first-look clock. There are no membership, seat, or per-deal charges for builders. Partners Register a parcel before first contact and it is locked to you for 30 days from submission. During the lock we do not work that parcel around you. Partners keep 50% of the net assignment fee actually collected on their deals, paid when the fee is collected. Partner work is 100% commission — no salary, hourly pay, or draw is offered or implied. Unregistered leads are not protected. How pricing works Parcels are priced off recorded sales of comparable property in the same market — what we call builder value: what a builder credibly pays for property of that kind, from the record. Our contract target is 65% of that figure. The methodology describes how we price; it is not an appraisal, not a valuation opinion, and not a promise of what any property will sell or appraise for. Communications When you send a form or contact us, we may reply by email, phone, or text about your property, your registration, or your buy box. Message and data rates may apply on texts. Tell us to stop and we stop — one word is enough, and it is honored across every channel we run. Partner conduct Partners work owners directly, by hand, on their own phones and their own accounts. Automated bulk outreach to property owners is not part of this platform and is not authorized in our name. A partner who misrepresents the model — including describing an assignment as a direct purchase by Lot &amp; Loaded — loses the lock and the registration. Changes These terms may change as the platform grows. The version on this page is the current one; a signed contract is governed by its own terms, not by this page. No guarantees We do not guarantee that a property will sell, that a deal will close, or that any timeline will hold. Pricing figures on this site describe our methodology — parcels priced off recorded comparable sales — not a promise about any individual property. Contact Lot &amp; Loaded · Call or text (838) 304-3003 · jesusasantiago413@gmail.com Lot &amp; Loaded — off-market commercial origination. Questions: call or text (838) 304-3003 · Terms · Privacy

===== Privacy | Lot & Loaded (https://santi856.github.io/lot-and-loaded/privacy.html)

Privacy | Lot &amp; Loaded LOT &amp; LOADED Builders Partners Sell your property Privacy What we collect, and what we never do with it. Last updated October 26, 2026. What we collect Only what the forms on this site ask for: your name, email, and phone number, and the property details you choose to send — address, acreage, zoning, asking price, and your notes about the property. This site also uses Google Analytics, which collects standard visit data (pages viewed, device, approximate location) through cookies. Why we collect it To run our process: verify the property, price it against recorded comparable sales, match it to qualified builders, and contact you about it. Builder packets contain property details a builder needs to evaluate a deal. Your contact details are shared only as needed to work and close a deal you are part of. What we never do We never sell your information. We never share it outside the deal process described above. We do not put you on marketing lists because you sent a form. Property information vs. personal information A deal packet is about a property, not a person. It carries the parcel's address, acreage, zoning, recorded comparable sales, and our pricing math. It does not carry a seller's phone number, email, or private notes — those stay in our intake system and are used only to work the deal with the seller directly. When a builder takes a deal, the closing paperwork is handled by the title company under its own privacy practices. Information from public records Commercial parcels are originated from public records — county property appraiser and tax rolls, recorded deeds, and court records. Those records are public by law. We use them to identify parcels and the entities that own them, and to verify acreage, zoning, tenure, and tax status before a parcel is ever offered to a builder. If you are an owner and want to know what public-record information we hold on your parcel, ask — we will show you, and the contact details are below. What we do not collect We never ask for, and you should never send us, bank account details, Social Security numbers, or payment card information through this site. Nothing is bought or paid for on this site. Fees move only inside a closing, through the title company, under the signed paperwork. How it is stored Form submissions are stored in our intake database, access-limited to the people working your deal. We keep a submission while a deal, registration, or conversation is active, and for a reasonable period afterward for our records. Analytics data is held by Google under Google's own policies. Texts and calls If you give us a phone number, we may call or text that number about the property, registration, or buy box you contacted us about. Reply STOP to any text and texting stops. Your number is never sold and never added to bulk campaigns. Children This is a business platform for commercial property. It is not directed at anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect information from minors. Changes If this policy changes, the new version is posted on this page with a new date. The version here is the one that applies. Your control Ask us what we hold on you, or ask us to delete it, any time: call or text (838) 304-3003, or email jesusasantiago413@gmail.com. We will confirm the deletion. Contact Lot &amp; Loaded · Call or text (838) 304-3003 · jesusasantiago413@gmail.com Lot &amp; Loaded — off-market commercial origination. Questions: call or text (838) 304-3003 · Terms · Privacy
